Subject: PacificRow availability for small CFO dinner — details & contract

Hi Oliver,

Hope you’re well — we’re planning a small, invitation-only dinner for ~18 CFOs in Seattle the week of Dec 7. PacificRow came highly recommended from a partner and your terrace would be perfect for a late-evening set (cocktail reception + seated dinner). Quick questions so we can move forward: 

- Do you have availability for Dec 8 or Dec 9 (preferred start 6:30pm)?
- Can you handle a plated 3-course dinner for 18 with a short welcome remarks setup (AV mic only)?
- Please share a sample venue contract (we’ll need standard indemnity, cancellation, and an insurance COI).
- We may need a mutual NDA for the invitation list (some guests are private-bank clients). Could you send a venue NDA or confirm you’ll sign ours?
- Any requirements for outside caterers or vendors?

I’ve cc’d Marissa (events) and Aditya (legal ops) — we’ll need to confirm final guest list and dietary restrictions by Nov 20 if possible. If you can send a draft contract and your COI, I’ll loop in procurement and our legal team.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Signature: +1 415-555-0129
From: Oliver Smith <oliver@harborevents.com>

Date: 2026-11-01T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PacificRow availability for small CFO dinner — details & contract

Mina — thanks for reaching out, we’d love to host. Dec 8 is currently available (Dec 9 is tentatively booked). Key points below and attached: pacificrow_draft_contract_v1.pdf, certificate_of_insurance.pdf.

- Capacity & layout: Terrace + private dining room can comfortably seat 20. We’ll provide basic AV (lapel mic + small speaker).
- Menu: We have plated 3-course options; I can send sample menus and pricing in a follow-up.
- Deposit & cancellation: 25% deposit to hold date; full refund window until 21 days prior. See attached contract v1 for standard terms.
- Insurance: COI attached showing $1M general liability. We can increase coverage if needed (additional cost).
- NDA: happy to sign a mutual NDA. We don’t require one to receive a guest list but understand the sensitivity.
- Vendor rules: outside florals/cake allowed; external caterers require prior approval (we can handle all food).

If the date works, I can provisionally hold Dec 8 for 72 hours while you circulate the contract internally. Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Oliver Smith
Director, Events — Harbor Events (PacificRow)
Attachment: pacificrow_draft_contract_v1.pdf (pdf), certificate_of_insurance.pdf (pdf)

Subject: TileCorp procurement — NDA & privacy requirements for invite acceptance

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for the invite and the quick coordination. A few procurement items from TileCorp before our CFO confirms attendance: 

1) Mutual NDA — TileCorp requires a mutual NDA when a guest list includes bank and payment customers. Please provide a mutual NDA for review or indicate if the venue will sign a venue-added confidentiality clause.
2) Photos & recordings — we prohibit public photo/video of our executives without prior written consent. Please confirm you will restrict photography and not publish attendee list publicly.
3) Insurance & vendor onboarding — we need the venue COI and Redwood’s vendor packet (W9 + contact for billing). If you have a vendor questionnaire, attach that as well.

Attached is our standard vendor questionnaire and a short checklist (procurement_questionnaire.pdf). Once those are returned we can clear Sarah internally.

procurement@tilecorp.com
